capabilities: indent the current line or each selected line by a configurable number of spaces (1-8)
unindent selected lines with Shift+Tab, removing one indent of leading spaces or a tab
delegate Tab and Shift+Tab in table cells to Advanced Tables when it is installed
extras: Explicitly documents behavior boundaries: Tab in the middle of plain text and Live Preview table cells are left to Obsidian or other plugins, and indenting a list item does not move child items.
intentEvidence: This plugin makes Tab indent by 2 spaces and Shift+Tab unindent by 2 spaces.
problem: Since Obsidian 1.8, Tab with 'Indent using tabs' off always inserts 4 spaces, and the tab size setting only changes display width, so users who want 2-space indents have no built-in option.

relations.evidence: if Advanced Tables is enabled, Tab / Shift+Tab run its Next cell / Previous cell commands

summary: Tab-key handler that indents the current line or selection by a configurable number of spaces instead of tabs or Obsidian's fixed 4 spaces.
